//: openclaw.json — the personal assistant's config. (M11, ADR-0020)
WHY A FILE AND NOT ENV VARS:
OpenClaw configures model providers here, not from bare environment
variables. Setting OPENAI_BASE_URL in compose and expecting it to be
picked up does NOT work — the variable is only meaningful because it is
referenced as ${OPENAI_BASE_URL} below. Verified against the provider
baseUrl points at CLIProxyAPI on net-agent, which re-exports the
operator's Claude subscription as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. There is
no Anthropic API key anywhere in this system (ADR-0020).
api: openai-completions is the correct type for any self-hosted
/v1/chat/completions backend, which is exactly what the proxy presents.
